newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITC leaves licence fees unchanged in Q1 "97.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITC leaves licence fees unchanged in Q1 "97.

text.p: The Independent Television Commission (ITC) said on Tuesday that fees payable by its licensees to fund its activities are to remain unchanged in the first quarter of 1997.
The fees totalled 15.7 million stg in 1996, the funding covering the cost to the ITC of licensing and regulating commercially funded television services.
The ITC will review its licence fee income requirements early next year and, if necessary, publish new tariffs which will take effect from April 1997.
In addition to the licence fees, commercial terrestrial (ITV) channels make an annual tender payment to the Treasury which consists of a percentage of revenue plus an additional pre-set cash sum.
